items.source: Extends MessageReceivingOperations and adds operations for receiving messages from a destination specified as a (resolvable) String name.
items.translation: 扩展MessageReceivingOperations并添加从指定为（可解析）String 名称的目的地接收消息的操作。

items.source: Resolve the given destination name and receive a message from it.
items.translation: 解析给定的目标名称并从中接收消息。

items.source:
Resolve the given destination name, receive a message from it,
convert the payload to the specified target type.
items.translation: 解析给定的目标名称，从其接收消息，并将负载转换为指定的目标类型。

items.source: D - the type of destination to receive messages from
items.translation: D - 接收消息的目的地类型

items.source: targetClass - the target class for the converted payload
